question: 从珠江路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离是多少米？

margin.sql: WITH o_p AS (SELECT ST_PointOnSurface(t.geom) AS pt FROM residential_areas t WHERE t.name = '邓府新村' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), 2100, false)), fac AS (SELECT t.id, t.geom AS pt FROM metro_stations t WHERE TRUE AND ST_DWithin(t.geom::geography, (SELECT pt FROM o)::geography, 2100)), snapped AS (SELECT f.id, v.id AS vid FROM fac f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> f.pt LIMIT 1) v) SELECT r.agg_cost AS d FROM snapped s JOIN reach r ON r.node = s.vid
